name: @arthur/desktop
description: Arthur local voice assistant desktop application

scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build --mode main && vite build --mode preload && vite build --mode renderer
scripts.package:unpacked: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package.ps1 -Target dir
scripts.package:nsis: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package.ps1 -Target nsis
scripts.package:release: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package.ps1 -Target nsis -RequireSignature

author: Microsoft Scout
